dialogue.ViridianCity_House_EventScript_BaldingMa: Coming up with nicknames is fun, but it's not so easy to do. Clever names are nice, but simple names are easier to remember.
dialogue.ViridianCity_Mart_EventScript_ParcelScen: Hey! You came from PALLET TOWN?
dialogue.ViridianCity_Mart_EventScript_SayHiToOak: Okay, thanks! Please say hi to PROF. OAK for me, too.
dialogue.ViridianCity_Mart_EventScript_Woman: This shop does good business in ANTIDOTES, I've heard.
dialogue.ViridianCity_Mart_EventScript_Youngster: I've got to buy some POTIONS. You never know when your Pokemon will need quick healing.
dialogue.ViridianCity_PokemonCenter_1F_EventScrip: There's a Pokemon CENTER in every town ahead. They charge no money, so don't be shy about healing Pokemon.
Please feel free to use that PC in the corner. The receptionist told me so. It's so kind of her!
Pokemon CENTERS heal your tired, hurt, or fainted Pokemon. They make all Pokemon completely healthy.
dialogue.ViridianCity_School_EventScript_Lass: Whew! I'm trying to memorize all my notes.
dialogue.ViridianCity_School_EventScript_Woman: Okay! Be sure to read what's on the blackboard carefully!
dialogue.ViridianCity_School_EventScript_Notebook: Let's check out the notebook. First page… Poke BALLS are used to catch Pokemon. Up to six Pokemon can be carried in your party. People who raise and battle with Pokemon are called TRAINERS.
dialogue.ViridianCity_School_EventScript_Blackboa: The blackboard lists Pokemon STATUS problems during battles.
dialogue.ViridianCity_School_EventScript_ChooseBl: Which topic do you want to read?
dialogue.ViridianCity_School_EventScript_ReadSlee: A Pokemon can't attack if it's asleep. Pokemon will stay asleep even after battles. Use AWAKENING to awaken one from sleep.
dialogue.ViridianCity_School_EventScript_ReadBurn: A burn reduces ATTACK power. It also causes ongoing HP loss. A burn remains after a battle. Use BURN HEAL to cure a burn.
dialogue.ViridianCity_School_EventScript_ReadPois: When poisoned, a Pokemon's health steadily drops. Poison lingers after battles. Use an ANTIDOTE to cure poison!
dialogue.ViridianCity_School_EventScript_ReadFree: A frozen Pokemon becomes helplessly immobile. It stays frozen even after the battle ends. Use ICE HEAL to thaw out the suffering Pokemon.
dialogue.ViridianCity_School_EventScript_ReadPara: Paralysis reduces SPEED and may prevent the Pokemon from moving. Paralysis remains after battles. Use PARLYZ HEAL for treatment.
dialogue.ViridianForest_EventScript_Youngster: I came here with some friends to catch us some BUG Pokemon! They're all itching to get into some Pokemon battles!
dialogue.ViridianForest_EventScript_Boy: I was throwing Poke BALLS to catch Pokemon, and I ran out. That's why you can never have too many Poke BALLS.
dialogue.ViridianForest_EventScript_TrainerTips1: TRAINER TIPS If your Pokemon are weak and you want to avoid battles, stay away from grassy areas!
dialogue.ViridianForest_EventScript_TrainerTips2: For poison, use ANTIDOTE! Get it at Pokemon MARTS!
dialogue.ViridianForest_EventScript_TrainerTips3: TRAINER TIPS Contact PROF. OAK via a PC to get your PokeDEX evaluated!
dialogue.ViridianForest_EventScript_TrainerTips4: TRAINER TIPS You can't catch a Pokemon that belongs to someone else. Throw Poke BALLS only at wild Pokemon to catch them!
dialogue.ViridianForest_EventScript_TrainerTips5: TRAINER TIPS Weaken Pokemon before attempting capture! When healthy, they may escape!
dialogue.ViridianForest_EventScript_ExitSign: LEAVING VIRIDIAN FOREST PEWTER CITY AHEAD
dialogue.ViridianForest_EventScript_Rick: Ssh! You'll scare the bugs away. Another time, okay?
dialogue.ViridianForest_EventScript_Doug: That totally stinks! I'm going to catch some stronger ones!
dialogue.ViridianForest_EventScript_Sammy: Sometimes, you can find stuff on the ground. I'm looking for the stuff I dropped. Can you help me?
dialogue.ViridianForest_EventScript_Anthony: I lost some of my allowance…
dialogue.ViridianForest_EventScript_Charlie: BUG Pokemon evolve quickly. They're a lot of fun!
